# Changelog

This page records notable changes to the Boundary Installation Guide.

## 2026-11

- Added field guidance from HashiCorp Professional Services engagements to the architecture, detailed design, deployment, secure proxy, private resources, and post-installation pages.
- New topics: single control plane design for segregated environments, a default network flow table, database access and initialization privileges, controller certificate SAN and chain guidance, AppRole delivery of Vault Transit KMS tokens, SSH host key validation on workers, retiring recovery KMS access after bootstrap, and reverse proxy access in place of per-host firewall rules.

## 2026-08

- Restructured legacy Boundary HVD content into the HVD 2.0 Boundary Installation Guide as part of the Installation / Administration / User guide migration.
